Transgressive segregation requires every active allele to be equal because only an even genetic distribution lets recombination in the F₂ produce novel combinations that surpass both parental phenotypes. With unequal alleles, the stronger allele would dominate and prevent offspring from exceeding the parental range. Thus equality of active alleles is what makes the transgressive excess possible.

This exhaustive refitting makes grid search reasonably slow for that task.

The neighbor’s probated will devised her entire estate to the charity, which shows that the neighbor—not the daughter—was the person with the future interest created by the original deed. That future interest was contingent because it depended on the friend’s life ending before the neighbor’s remainder could become possessory. Therefore, the friend has a life estate and the neighbor has a contingent remainder.

Because that cognitive framework underlies consistent behavioral tendencies such as openness, conscientiousness, and sociability, inherited intelligence becomes the direct source of personality differences. Therefore, heredity determines intelligence, which in turn completely determines personality.
